label: A snowball rolling (crunch)
prompt: A soft snowball rolling over fresh powder snow, one gentle packed-snow crunch, close and cozy, toy-like.

label: Patting a snowball together
prompt: Mittened hands patting a small snowball together, three quick soft pats on snow, gentle.

label: A snowball plops on top (stack)
prompt: A snowball landing on top of a bigger snowball, a soft round plop of packed snow with a tiny cartoon pop, cute.

label: The box pops open, a hat flies out
prompt: A cardboard box lid popping open with a cheerful cartoon pop and a soft fabric whoosh as a knitted hat flies out, playful.

label: A snowman wakes up
prompt: A gentle magical twinkle shimmer rising up, soft chimes and a tiny happy sparkle, a snowman coming to life, cute and warm.

label: The carnival trumpet
prompt: A friendly cartoon toy trumpet playing a short cheerful three-note fanfare, toot toot tooot, soft and bright, not loud.

label: The parade drum
prompt: One big soft bass drum hit at an outdoor winter parade, warm and round, a little boom, no other instruments.

label: Sleigh bells on the carriage
prompt: Sleigh bells jingling softly a few times as a horse trots, merry and light, winter.

label: A snowball boings off his tummy
prompt: A big funny rubbery cartoon boing, a snowball bouncing off a round jelly-like tummy, wobbly spring sound, silly and cute.

label: A snowman dozing
prompt: One tiny cute cartoon snore with a soft little whistle on the out breath, sleepy and gentle.

label: The carnival far off (bed)
prompt: A calm snowy winter park with a carnival far away: soft muffled happy crowd in the distance, faint sleigh bells now and then, gentle cold breeze, snow-quiet and cozy. Seamless loop, no music, no voices up close.
